builds.title: Cliffside lookout, Rogue 1
builds.senses: Passive Perception 15, or 20 for checks relying on sight.
builds.languages: Giant Eagle. Understands, reads, and writes Common, Auran, and Elvish. Can only speak Giant Eagle. Knows thieves' cant.
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +3. Unarmored AC 10 + 3 Dexterity. No equipment on patrol.
Rogue supplies Acrobatics, Insight, Perception, and Stealth. Expertise doubles proficiency for Perception and Stealth. Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Elvish, and Wanderer.
Keen Sight gives advantage on sight-based Perception checks. Slatebeak recognizes signs used in thieves' cant and can encode spoken messages in Giant Eagle.
actions: Talons. Dexterity-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 piercing. Counts as a finesse weapon for Sneak Attack.

Sneak Attack. Once per turn on a talon hit, add 1d6 if the attack roll has advantage. It also applies without advantage when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Slatebeak lacks disadvantage.
builds.tactics: Slatebeak circles beyond reach, then dives when someone on the ground draws the target's attention. He gives a warning cry before attacking an intruder.

builds.title: Floodgate keeper, Barbarian 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. Unarmored Defense is 10 + 2 Dexterity + 2 Constitution. Carries no gear and breathes air and water.
Barbarian supplies Nature and Perception. Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Aquan, and Wanderer.
actions: Bite. Strength-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 piercing, or 1d8+5 while raging.

Bite grip. After landing a bite through the Attack action, spend a bonus action to grapple the creature hit if it is within reach and no larger than Large. Athletics +5 contests its choice of Athletics or Acrobatics. Rage gives Silt advantage on the check. An incapacitated target within those limits is grabbed automatically.

Rage. Bonus action, twice per long rest, for up to 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and +2 damage with Strength-based melee weapon attacks. Rage ends if knocked unconscious or if a turn ends without attacking a hostile creature or taking damage since the previous turn. Can also end it with a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Silt keeps his chin just above the water and asks what the party wants. In a fight he clamps onto the first creature reaching for the sluice lever.

builds.title: Caravan night watch, Barbarian 2
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. Unarmored Defense is 10 + 1 Dexterity + 2 Constitution. HP starts at 14 and adds 9 at 2nd level. No armor or carried gear.
Barbarian supplies Animal Handling and Perception. Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Gnoll, and Wanderer.
Danger Sense grants advantage on Dexterity saves against visible effects while free of blindness, deafness, and incapacitation.
actions: Bite. Strength-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 piercing, or 1d8+5 while raging.
Rampage. When Rattlejaw reduces a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack on her turn, she can spend a bonus action to move up to 15 ft. and make one bite attack.
Reckless Attack. Choose on the first attack of the turn to give Strength-based melee weapon attacks advantage that turn. Attacks against Rattlejaw have advantage until her next turn.

Rage. Bonus action, twice per long rest, for up to 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and +2 damage with Strength-based melee weapon attacks. Rage ends if knocked unconscious or if a turn ends without attacking a hostile creature or taking damage since the previous turn. Can also end it with a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Rattlejaw lures intruders away from the tethered animals, then charges the easiest one to knock down. She can Rampage on a turn with a bonus action available.

builds.title: Wreck surveyor, Monk 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Dexterity save +4. Monk Unarmored Defense is 10 + 2 Dexterity + 1 Wisdom. Carries no gear in this encounter.
Monk grants History, Stealth, and proficiency with mason's tools. Sailor grants Athletics, Perception, navigator's tools, water vehicles, and Ship's Passage.
Breathes water only and can hold its breath for an hour. Can move through a 1-inch opening without squeezing. Can manipulate most items and has advantage on underwater Stealth checks.
actions: Tentacle. Strength-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 bludgeoning. Martial Arts also permits Dexterity at +4 for 1d8+2.

Martial Arts. After using the Attack action for a tentacle strike, may spend a bonus action on a conventional unarmed headbutt at +5 for 1d4+3 bludgeoning. Kamstra's monk rule on p. 7 uses the monk die for this strike.

Ink Cloud. For this encounter, spend an action while underwater to heavily obscure a 20-ft. radius around Dunewick for up to 1 minute, with a significant current dispersing the ink early. Immediately after release may Dash as a bonus action. Recharges on a short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Dunewick waits in a ceiling recess and tries to parley before approaching. If outnumbered, he inks the corridor and swims through a narrow gap.

concepts.name: Slatebeak
concepts.role: Keeps watch over the ledges between two cliff paths.
concepts.motive: Find who moved the warning markers while he was hunting.
concepts.hook: A fresh white marker points to a ledge that fell two winters ago.

concepts.name: Silt
concepts.role: Keeps boats away from a broken floodgate.
concepts.motive: Learn why the latest gate crew hammered the sluice shut.
concepts.hook: Silt can hear someone knocking from inside the sealed wheel chamber.

concepts.name: Rattlejaw
concepts.role: Guards the night tether lines at an old caravan stop.
concepts.motive: Find the person who keeps slipping the best pack animals out of their halters.
concepts.hook: A bell rang from a pen Rattlejaw had already cleared.

concepts.name: Dunewick
concepts.role: Surveys wrecks and marks passages safe for divers.
concepts.motive: Free a chart case wedged beneath a collapsed deck beam.
concepts.hook: Dunewick traced the last crew's route, but their ship has no recorded port of origin.
